group.ja: 温度制御・分子動力学

summary.ja: 近傍粒子対の相対速度の一成分を確率的に再抽選し、対の重心運動量を保つ衝突型の温度制御。
summary.en: Stochastically redraw a component of a nearby pair’s relative velocity while preserving the pair’s center-of-mass momentum.

caution.ja: 独立な粒子速度を引き直すAndersen法と区別する。衝突頻度や近傍半径は粘性・拡散などの輸送に影響する。
caution.en: Distinguish from independent-particle Andersen collisions. Collision frequency and neighbor radius affect transport such as viscosity and diffusion.

references.label: Lowe (1999), An alternative approach to dissipative particle dynamics
references.scope: Bibliographic entry and introductory comparison; full derivation and numerical reproduction have not been audited.

next_deliverable.ja: 専用の定式化・積分手順を整理し、固定入力、自由度・乱数・刻み幅を明記した分布と時間相関の検証例を追加する。
next_deliverable.en: Add a dedicated formulation and integration recipe, followed by explicit-input distribution and time-correlation checks with stated degrees of freedom, random seeds and step sizes.

limitations.ja: 比較解説を公開。Under construction：専用の実装・数値検証結果はまだありません。
limitations.en: Comparative reading is available. No dedicated implementation or numerical verification result is provided yet.
